_what: Labelled student queries for the Ask AI intent classifier.
_provenance: The first five are real, taken from AskAISavedQuery on the live database (the only genuine ones stored at the time). The rest are hand-written in the same register and are NOT observed traffic - treat accuracy measured here as indicative, not as a production metric.
_why: Intent was a hard filter in vector_service._passes_filters, so a wrong label silently removed most of the corpus: 'data science internships in Bangalore' was labelled research, and only 59 of 203 Bangalore listings carry research/fellowship/assistant. Any change to how intent is trusted needs a set to measure against.

queries.query: software internships that fit React and TypeScript skills
remote internships for data science and analytics with citations
